info.name: COMP3123 Assignment 1 - Employee Management API (101549617)
info.description:
Secure REST API built with Node.js, Express, MongoDB and JWT.

Run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner (or `npx newman run`). Signup creates two fresh users (User A and User B) on every run; their JWTs and employee IDs are stored in collection variables.

Before running: start the API (`npm run dev`) and make sure `baseUrl` points to it. Optional: run `npm run token:expired` and paste the token into the `expiredToken` variable.

The last folder triggers the login rate limiter, so restart the server before running the collection again.

item.name: 09 Rate Limiting (run last)
item.description: Repeated failed logins from the same IP are blocked with 429 Too Many Requests (default: 5 failed attempts per 15 minutes). In the Collection Runner the first request repeats itself until 429 is returned; when sending manually, click Send repeatedly. Restart the server (or wait for the window to pass) before running the collection again.
